title: - - Concatenation. Removes trailing blanks from the element preceding the operator then joins two elements. (Character Operators)
+ - Concatenation. Joins two strings, a string and a field, or a string and a variable. (Character Operators)
<= - Less than or equal to (Relational Operators)
>= - Greater than or equal to (Relational Operators)
$ - Comparison. Seeks one character expression within another. (Character Operators)
